title: Supply Chain Analyst
content: <p>Maple Goods sells kitchen tools.</p><p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p><ul><li>Forecast demand and set reorder points</li></ul><p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p><ul><li>1-3 years of experience in supply chain or retail</li><li>Strong Excel and SQL</li></ul><p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p><ul><li>Tableau</li></ul><p><strong>Benefits</strong></p><ul><li>401(k) with a $2,000 to $4,000 match</li></ul>
